title: Shiraishi An — A Bit Of Frustration〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Nice work today!
We'll see you two tomorrow!!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, see you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane, let's head back together for part of the way!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I still sorta can't believe we're putting on our own event.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Since we're going to be putting on an event, why don't all of you also try putting one together?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I bet it'll turn out great since you have Kohane and the guys now. Plus, you've all been practicing a ton together!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I was so surprised when we went from Len and the others doing an event to them saying, “Why don't you try putting one together as well?”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. I was just as surprised.
Everything happened so fast.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I'd like to do my best if we're actually going through with this.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, same! Let's make it an event to remember!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, also, Kohane...
Remember what Akito said?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Um... Are you talking about RAD WEEKEND's atmosphere?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, that!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The heart-pounding sensation I felt that time... It's really hard for me to describe, but it really was an incredible atmosphere...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Akito mentioned this too, but I'm sure we'll get closer to surpassing RAD WEEKEND if we can produce the same sort of vibe.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I remember you mentioning that before, An.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: As the night went on, the crowd kept getting more and more pumped as each team battled to be the best.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They wanted to sing more and everyone wanted to hear more like they couldn't get enough. As a result, it reached a status that no one thought was possible...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's what RAD WEEKEND was all about, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You remembered my story?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Of course I did, An.
The way your eyes sparkled as you told it made me want to learn more about what it was like.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And I'm really glad that I got to see a video of RAD WEEKEND itself.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Me too. It reminded me just how amazing that night was and how there's so much that you can't put into words.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But if we're seriously gonna surpass it, we might wanna stop putting it on such a high pedestal.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let's keep doing our best to figure out how to produce that atmosphere and see what we can do during our event!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also, I'm really surprised that Akito decided to go along with KAITO's idea...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, you are?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well, I dunno... I was half expecting him to say that it's too soon for us to put on our own event or something.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, despite how he looks, Akito's actually pretty mature and is pretty deliberate about most stuff, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. He is always looking out for us during practice and events.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Exactly! I really don't know if this is good or bad, but he seemed to think that it was worth a shot...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And on top of all that, I'm staggered by how surprised I was when KAITO suggested that we do our own event.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I thought I was mentally ready to pounce on it and be all, “Yeah, let's do it!”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So a part of you regrets not doing that?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: A part of me? No, pretty much all of me!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Which is why I wanna knock the socks off Akito and the others by singing some really amazing songs during the event. Then, we'll be square again...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Sounds like a heated battle between the four of us is about to unfold.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Trying to outdo your own teammates also probably played a role in creating that atmosphere.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (And we're gonna do everything we can to recreate the heart-pounding sensation I felt that night.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Because now I have...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (The best team and best partner ever!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
An...?
Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Nope, nothing!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, starting tomorrow, we're really gonna kick some butt!
